question: Will School Re:Zero (Vainglory If) continue? Now that so many new characters have appeared, I'd love to see a continuation of School Re:Zero where these characters appear as well.
answer:
I think I've only written up through before Arc 6 for now, so if I were to introduce Vollachia at this point, I'd probably have enough material to write an entirely new school. (laughs)

I've been writing School Re as an April Fools' project, but I only write it in years when I can't think of anything else to write.

But if there are people who want me to write it, then I might write it someday.
